messages.subject: Project Falcon - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark,

Attached is a first draft of the Heads of Terms reflecting the economics you described: EV £28m, equity value £25.4m on a cash-free/debt-free basis, with £22.9m cash at completion, £1.5m in escrow for 18 months and up to £1m earn-out on FY2026 EBITDA. I've built in a 4-week exclusivity period (binding) and the usual subject-to-contract wording.

Grateful for your comments before we send to Castle & Vane.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate / M&A
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
sarah.whitfield@whitfieldcarter.com | +44 20 7946 0833
